name: Skyline Construction · Crane & Earthworks
label: Build a city skyscraper
description: An animated city construction site: operate a 78-metre tower crane, lift and stack steel beams into a 16-floor skyscraper, excavate foundations, grade earth with a crawler bulldozer and haul spoil with an articulated dump truck. Realistic joystick functions, live machinery dashboards and synchronized multiplayer building.

functionalSettings.prompt: Operate Atlas TC-78 Tower Crane · E / Use
Operate HT-40 Articulated Dump Truck · E / Use
Operate D9 Crawler Bulldozer · E / Use
Operate EX-300 Hydraulic Excavator · E / Use

dialogueSettings.text: Build the city skyline together. Enter the crane with E / Use. Slew the jib, run the trolley and raise or lower the hook; attach a steel beam, lift it to the highlighted tower target, then release to secure it. Four beams raise each new floor. Use the working excavator, bulldozer and dump truck for earthworks. Each machine has its own joystick dashboard.

Crane controls: left joystick slews and runs the trolley; right joystick hoists. Lower the hook to the steel supply, attach a load, raise it, slew to the tower and lower onto the highlighted target. The server shares each movement and placed beam with everyone on site.

Excavate the marked cut with the hydraulic boom and bucket, grade with the bulldozer blade, and use the dump truck to carry spoil to the stockpile. Stop before leaving a machine. Hide the dashboard with its collapse button to clear your view.
